scope: Proposition 3.7 of the manuscript “The Bogomolov-Pop reconstruction theorem” (preprints/The-Bogomolov-Pop-reconstruction-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 009 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d805627401fffef), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the setting of Proposition 3.5, let w and v be matched quasi-prime (d − 1)- divisors. Then lw is algebraic over a finite field if and only if kv is. When this holds, the induced isomorphism WLw → WKv carries the full family of point inertia subgroups of the respective smooth projective curves onto each other. Corresponding normalized order characters differ by units of Zℓ.
